title: Sell or connect only approved gas appliances
what: Sell Type A gas appliances, and prescribed components, only if approved, labelled and compliant with the relevant standard.

sources.title: Gas Safety Act 2019 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person must not sell a Type A appliance, or a component of a prescribed class, unless the appliance or component – (a) is approved as required under this Division; and (b) is labelled as required under this Division
